description: Lists the GetAccountED books this sign-in can work on, with their business_id. Use it first when the user is an accounting practice and asks about a particular client, then pass that business_id to the other accounting_ tools. For a single business it simply confirms which books are connected. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).
name: accounting_list_my_businesses
title: List my businesses / clients
